scripts.build: tsc --build && pnpm --filter @texaryn/angular build && pnpm --filter @texaryn/svelte build && pnpm --filter @texaryn/solid build && node scripts/vendor-schema-json-runtime.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/collaboration-yjs/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/schema-json/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/schema-json-hyperjump/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react-bootstrap/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react-mui/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/vue/tsconfig.typecheck.json && pnpm --filter @texaryn/angular typecheck && pnpm --filter @texaryn/svelte typecheck && pnpm --filter @texaryn/solid typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web-components/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/hints-rjsf/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/examples/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/playground/tsconfig.typecheck.json
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- docs/api)"
scripts.site:build: pnpm --filter @texaryn/docs build && pnpm --filter @texaryn/playground build:pages && node scripts/compose-site.mjs && node scripts/check-site-links.mjs apps/docs/dist && node scripts/check-theme-contract.mjs apps/docs/dist
